title: Free simplicial resolutions for conservative realization-preserving right adjoints
statement: Use the universe and infinity-category conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and coherent diagrams and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal X,\mathcal B$ be infinity-categories and let $L:\mathcal B\rightleftarrows\mathcal X:R$ be a coherent adjunction: $L$ is left adjoint to $R$, via natural equivalences $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal X}(Lb,x)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal B}(b,Rx)$. Suppose $\mathcal X$ admits all small geometric realizations, meaning colimits of coherent diagrams indexed by $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$, and $R$ preserves these colimits and reflects equivalences. For every $x\in\mathcal X$ there exist a coherent simplicial diagram $P:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal X$ and a colimiting cocone $P\to\operatorname{const}(x)$ such that, for every integer $n\geq0$, there are $b_n\in\mathcal B$ and an equivalence $P_n\simeq L(b_n)$. No assertion that the objects $b_n$ form a simplicial diagram in $\mathcal B$ is imposed.

source.place: Higher Algebra (2017), Proposition 4.7.3.14, printed p.689, using conditions (1) and (2) of Theorem 4.7.3.5. The present hypotheses require all geometric realizations rather than only the right-adjoint-split ones. No Stacks tag for this infinity-categorical theorem.
